text: おれに　なんか　よーじ　だって？

structure.jp: おれに　なんか　よーじ　だって？
structure.en: you say there's some business with me?

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: って is the casual form of と that repeats what someone said; with a question tone it means 'you say...?'. よーじ　だって？ = 'you say you have business with me?'.
